_comment: Shieldbearer companion (content pass C7, plan-content-zones12.md §13): the HoldTheLine summon — a tanky wall soldier that drums shields onto its squad and owner (reuses the RallyDrum mob skill, allies-only). Companion pattern verbatim (owned, caster-aligned follower; spawnSummon overrides faction from the caster, hence no faction key; never a zone spawn): collisionLayer 160 = Viewport|Player, collisionMask 17 = PlayerStatic|Border, speed above the player's so it keeps up, aggroRadius dummy (followers ride owner combat signals). curveLevel 1 — power comes from SummonPower x f(ownerLevel), not the curve.
